title: Uniform computation of the squared-logarithmic k-server bound
summary: We construct a uniform randomized k -server algorithm on finite rational metrics with competitive ratio $`O(\log^2(k+1))`$ against oblivious request sequences. Preprocessing is polynomial in the input length, and per-request bit complexity is polynomial in that length and the binary request-counter length. The additive movement constant is finite and instance-dependent, but may be enormous. The construction uses the companion squared-logarithmic existence theorem.
family_title: Optimal-order randomized k -server on arbitrary metrics

review.reason: Constructs a randomized k-server algorithm with a squared-logarithmic competitive ratio on finite metrics.
